scope: Generic fixed-epoch base CSR contribution of exact q/s event ports; donor only, no solver or stage admission
limitations: PN/APL and other specialized row/weight replacements are not included and require a versioned extension
No biological calibration or tau grouping
Timing is isolated operator timing, not organism speedup
information: Captured legal source rows, q/s initial states, exact taus, ordered SET/ADD events, fixed effective base W, caps, visual mask, scale, connected flag and the original 60 query times
hypothesis: A source-restricted CSR can reconstruct the port contribution within the frozen current tolerance while traversing at least 10 times fewer edges than the full base CSR for that contribution

alternatives.A_selected: Source-restricted CSR, analytic exact per-source q/s and deterministic receptor reduction; pure arbitrary-time queries support speculative rollback
alternatives.B_not_implemented: Source CSC scatter of exact per-source analytic changes with versioned chronological checkpoints; conflict and rollback overhead may remove savings
alternatives.C_not_implemented: Certified per-source quantized q/s updates through CSC with an omitted-current bound; bound propagation and event cuts may require near-global updates

comparison: One full and one reduced GPU query per each of the original 60 timestamps, with the same independently reconstructed release; two channels retain signed nonvisual current and positive/negative visual conductance. Reduced vs full CUDA sums may differ in rounding order. Edge work is reported both steady and with one global partition pass; measured preparation time is also included separately. cuda/weights is a captured snapshot after coefficient return, not a claim about transient specialized overrides.
guards: late inserted event invalidates prepared epoch
repeated same-time SET preserves source order
incorrect W version rejects query before launch
stopping: Stop after the single bounded probe or any validation/budget failure; no tolerance changes or biological/solver claim
